# GENERATED for polymul/negacyclic@1.0.0. Do not edit.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(fherma_solution LANGUAGES CXX CUDA)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CUDA_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CUDA_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE)
  set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Release)
endif()
set(FHERMA_CUDA_ARCH sm_89 CACHE STRING "nvcc -arch value")
add_executable(solution main.cpp solve.cu)
target_include_directories(solution PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
set_target_properties(solution PROPERTIES CUDA_ARCHITECTURES OFF CUDA_SEPARABLE_COMPILATION ON)
target_compile_options(solution PRIVATE $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CUDA>:-arch=${FHERMA_CUDA_ARCH};-dlto>)
target_link_options(solution PRIVATE $<DEVICE_LINK:-arch=${FHERMA_CUDA_ARCH};-dlto>)
if(DEFINED ENV{CUPQC_SDK_DIR})
  target_include_directories(solution PRIVATE $ENV{CUPQC_SDK_DIR}/include $ENV{CUPQC_SDK_DIR}/include/cupqc)
  target_link_libraries(solution PRIVATE $ENV{CUPQC_SDK_DIR}/lib/libcupqc-bigint.a)
endif()
